description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Consumer Direct Care Network provides home and community-based services supporting older adults and individuals with disabilities. The Software Engineer I analyzes requirements, develops and tests software, deploys Azure-based cloud components, supports front-end and back-end applications, maintains databases, and troubleshoots software issues under guidance.
Entry-level Azure software developer building cloud services, web applications, databases, and user interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Assist in developing basic software components and features under supervision
• Deploy and author code for cloud infrastructure and software components on the Microsoft Azure platform, including:
• Azure Functions
• Service Bus
• Logic Apps
• Cosmos DB (NoSQL)
• Support front-end development by designing simple user interactions on web pages
• Contribute to developing basic back-end web applications
• Assist in creating and maintaining simple databases (e.g., MSSQL)
• Help ensure application responsiveness and cross-platform optimization
• Participate in small projects or assist with components of larger efforts
• Learn and apply internal coding standards and development best practices
• Troubleshoot bugs and assist with resolving software issues under guidance
• Stay current on emerging technologies and programming languages relevant to the role

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
• 0–2 years of related experience in software development
• Basic understanding of object-oriented programming (e.g., C#, Java, C++)
• Familiarity with fundamental front-end languages such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Basic knowledge of server-side languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python, PHP, .NET)
• Understanding of database concepts; familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server preferred
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Excellent verbal and written communication
• Demonstrated eagerness to learn, receive feedback, and grow professionally
• Ability to work flexible or extended hours as needed
• Employees must provide their own reliable internet if working a remote/hybrid position
• The employee is regularly required to sit, talk, or hear; frequently required to use repetitive hand motion, handle or feel, and to stand, walk, reach, bend or lift up to 40 pounds

Preferred:
• Exposure to front-end frameworks such as Angular is a plus
